Only the synchronous expression API rejects a reached nonzero SLEEP. Query operators evaluate through evaluate_async, and static DML expansion excludes volatile expressions (rust/crates/tx/src/submission.rs:51), so SQL and XTQL SLEEP never reach it.

codes.rationale: The reference splices the raw XTQL regexp-replace pattern form into generated code and evals it, so any Clojure host form runs. RTDB interprets a bounded subset of pure forms; full parity needs a Clojure interpreter and would carry the reference's code-injection behaviour.

codes.rationale: BOOL_AND/BOOL_OR/EVERY over non-boolean emitted types: the reference reducing aggregate has no vector setter for them and throws.
MIN/MAX into decimal, small or unsigned integer, half-float or time vectors: the reference reducing aggregate's output vector has no matching setter and throws.
SUM into a byte or short accumulator: the reference Sum vector has no sumInto implementation for those widths.
VAR_*/STDDEV_* over inputs other than int, long or double: the reference squareInto is only implemented on those vectors.
CA certificate URI names with a named IPv6 interface scope or a trailing-dot host are resolved by the JDK's URIName against the host's interfaces and resolver; the result depends on the JVM host.
Historical xtql/call transaction legs are decoded for replay but cannot be re-encoded as source operations; the reference no longer has these operations.
codes.reference: No reference equivalent at the pinned revision: xtql and call tx-ops were removed.

codes.rationale: Arrow types with no XTDB vector mapping (LargeUtf8, views, large lists, ...) in stored files or client batches.
A custom Avro logical type is a Java class registered with LogicalTypes.register on the JVM classpath; a native node cannot load it.
Schema text reaches the reader from UTF-8 Registry responses, which cannot hold unmatched UTF-16 units.
Consulted only when the two adjacent doubles around log10(2) floor fixed-decimal precision differently, which depends on the JVM's Math.log10 last-ulp result; realistic fixed sizes never reach it.
Token buffer capacity invariant of the native reader; no input selects a smaller buffer than it requests.
Numbers longer than 1,000 characters exceed Jackson's default StreamReadConstraints maxNumberLength, which the reference parser also rejects.
Bounded size of the projected schema text handed to the native Avro backend.
Decimal logical types must be 32, 64, 128 or 256 bits wide to map onto Arrow decimal storage.
Run-end-encoded legs inside dense unions are rejected; XTDB unions carry plain legs only.
Half-precision floats: the reference vector factory errors on FloatingPoint HALF.
Null, bottom and nested run-end layouts have no Arrow run-end encoding.
Arrow dense-union type ids are a signed byte, so a union holds at most 127 legs.
codes.reference: Arrow columnar format: dense union type ids are int8.

codes.rationale: An Arrow extension name outside the XTDB set in a stored file or client batch has no logical type.
codes.reference: No reference equivalent: the JVM ExtensionTypeRegistry leaves unknown extensions as their storage type.

codes.rationale: AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS values outside the DefaultAzureCredential set; the Java Azure SDK rejects them with IllegalArgumentException at credential construction.
Interval constructor field/precision arguments are produced as literals by the SQL planner; a non-literal reaches the reference codegen with a nil :literal and fails.
SQL grammar only admits an unsigned-integer precision; a non-literal XTQL precision fails the reference assertion.
codes.reference: core/src/main/clojure/xtdb/expression/temporal.clj:1721 (assert (integer? precision) "precision must be literal for now").

codes.rationale: SQL EXTRACT/DATE_TRUNC fields are keywords in the grammar; a non-literal XTQL field reaches the reference with a nil :literal and the field case throws IllegalArgumentException.
The SQL DATE_TRUNC timezone is a character-string literal in the grammar; a non-literal XTQL timezone reaches ZoneId/of with nil and throws.
Zoned RANGE_BINS inputs at a unit other than microseconds fail the reference assertion.
= and <> between two sets throw UnsupportedOperationException in the reference.
Printing an ExceptionInfo transit value embeds the JVM construction stack trace, which a native implementation cannot reproduce.
ROUND(smallint/tinyint, scale): the reference case only maps :i32 and :i64 to a decimal precision and throws IllegalArgumentException otherwise.
Consistency check on the native symbol intern table; Registry input cannot alter interned content.
Avro schema documents above 256 KiB or with text above 50,000 units are rejected; the reference accepts them up to Jackson's limits. Listed in the kafka-avro-registry-and-producer resolution.
A schema the Java parser accepts but the native Avro backend cannot represent; observed cases are tracked by differential-equivalence.
specific.avro.reader and schema.reflection with named schemas load generated Java classes through SpecificData and ReflectData.
Registry response bodies outside the bounded native decoding profile.
A custom ConfigProvider is a Java class; the native adapters cover the File, Directory and EnvVar providers that kafka-clients ships.
Environment names or values that are not valid process-encoded text.
GSSAPI, OAUTHBEARER and custom JAAS login modules are rejected; PLAIN and SCRAM are implemented. Listed in the kafka-configurations resolution.
Interceptor, login handler and callback handler classes would run Java code inside the client.
Binary-format parameters of duration, oid, regclass or regproc: those PgTypes do not override readBinary.
Result encodings a PgType does not implement.
JSON-LD xt:timeZone, xt:period, xt:symbol, xt:table, xt:type and xt:field decode to JVM objects with no Arrow vector type, and unknown types are rejected by the decoder.
Maps with non-string, non-keyword keys have no document type.
pgoutput message tags other than R, Y, B, C, I, U and D.
Symbols have no Arrow vector type.
Text values of oid, regclass or regproc columns: those PgTypes do not override readText.
Transit tags that decode to JVM objects without an Arrow vector type.
Stored column-metadata type descriptors outside the encodable set.
codes.reference: No reference equivalent: RTDB column-metadata encoding.

codes.rationale: Ingest nodes have a fixed database set and no query surface; the reference refuses attach/detach there too.
codes.reference: core/src/main/kotlin/xtdb/api/IngestNode.kt:70-84 FixedDbCatalog error("can't attach a database to an ingest node").

codes.rationale: All 66 binder sites are sqlparser-rs dialect constructs that Sql.g4 has no rule for, grammar alternatives that sql.clj has no visitor for or explicitly throws on (window names and frames, ranking windows, a second window function, CTE column aliases, schema-qualified wildcards, DISTINCT on non-distinct aggregates), or branches that RTDB pre-processing makes unreachable (RETURNING, LIKE ANY, session control). The reference reports most of these as an incorrect xtdb/sql-error parse failure, where RTDB reports unsupported.
Evaluator fallback after planning: plan typing rejects unknown functions with xtdb.expression/function-type-mismatch, or types them null/bottom so evaluation returns before the fallback.
Null and bottom have no run-end encoding.
Unsigned integers and half floats have no JVM type EDN rendering; the reference vector types never contain them.
